entries.definition_en: to move from one place to another
entries.example_en: We go to Hue by train every summer.
entries.example_vi: Mùa hè nào nhà mình cũng đi Huế bằng tàu hỏa.
entries.cloze_en: Every summer, we go to Hue by train.

entries.definition_en: a big vehicle that carries many people on a route
entries.example_en: The number 9 bus goes to the zoo.
entries.example_vi: Xe buýt số 9 đi đến sở thú.
entries.cloze_en: The number 9 bus stops near my school and takes us to the zoo.

entries.definition_en: a vehicle with four wheels for a few people
entries.example_en: My uncle drives his car to work.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình lái ô tô đi làm.
entries.cloze_en: My uncle drives his car to work every day.

entries.definition_en: a bicycle
entries.example_en: I ride my bike to the park on weekends.
entries.example_vi: Cuối tuần mình đạp xe ra công viên.
entries.cloze_en: I ride my bike to the park and back on weekends.

entries.definition_en: a big town where many people live and work
entries.example_en: Ho Chi Minh City is very busy at night.
entries.example_vi: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh rất nhộn nhịp về đêm.
entries.cloze_en: Hanoi is a big city with many people, shops and tall buildings.

entries.definition_en: using a bus to travel
entries.example_en: My sister goes to school by bus.
entries.example_vi: Chị mình đi học bằng xe buýt.
entries.cloze_en: I wait at the bus stop and go to school by bus.

entries.definition_en: to move toward the place where the speaker is
entries.example_en: Can you come to my house on Sunday?
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật bạn đến nhà mình được không?
entries.cloze_en: It's my birthday on Sunday. Can you come to my party?

entries.definition_en: in or to this place
entries.example_en: Come here and sit next to me.
entries.example_vi: Lại đây ngồi cạnh mình nè.
entries.cloze_en: Come here and sit next to me.

entries.definition_en: a place with houses and shops, smaller than a city
entries.example_en: My grandparents live in a small town near the sea.
entries.example_vi: Ông bà mình sống ở một thị trấn nhỏ gần biển.
entries.cloze_en: My grandparents live in a small town near the sea.

entries.definition_en: to move on your feet at a normal speed
entries.example_en: I walk to school with my brother.
entries.example_vi: Mình đi bộ đến trường với anh trai.
entries.cloze_en: I don't have a bike, so I walk to school every day.

entries.definition_en: in or to that place
entries.example_en: The market is over there, next to the bank.
entries.example_vi: Chợ ở đằng kia, cạnh ngân hàng.
entries.cloze_en: Do you see the market over there, next to the bank?

entries.definition_en: a long vehicle that moves on rails
entries.example_en: We take the night train from Hanoi.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi chuyến tàu đêm từ Hà Nội.
entries.cloze_en: At the station, we get on the train to Hue.

entries.definition_en: a road in a town or city with houses on it
entries.example_en: There are many small shops on this street.
entries.example_vi: Con phố này có nhiều cửa hàng nhỏ.
entries.cloze_en: There are many small shops on this street.

entries.definition_en: to move through the air, or to travel by plane
entries.example_en: We fly to Phu Quoc for our vacation.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình bay ra Phú Quốc nghỉ mát.
entries.cloze_en: We fly to Da Nang by plane for our vacation.

entries.definition_en: a picture that shows where roads and places are
entries.example_en: Let's look at the map to find the hotel.
entries.example_vi: Mình xem bản đồ để tìm khách sạn nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Let's look at the map to find the way to the hotel.

entries.definition_en: the road or path to get to a place
entries.example_en: Excuse me, is this the way to the station?
entries.example_vi: Cho hỏi đây có phải đường ra ga không ạ?
entries.cloze_en: Excuse me, is this the way to the train station?

entries.definition_en: a place where a bus stops to let people on and off
entries.example_en: I wait for the bus at the bus stop near my school.
entries.example_vi: Mình đợi xe ở trạm xe buýt gần trường.
entries.cloze_en: I wait for the number 5 bus at the bus stop near my school.

entries.definition_en: a place where people keep and take out money
entries.example_en: My mom goes to the bank on Monday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Hai mẹ mình đi ngân hàng.
entries.cloze_en: My mom goes to the bank to get money.

entries.definition_en: a small vehicle that moves on water
entries.example_en: We take a boat to the island.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình đi thuyền ra đảo.
entries.cloze_en: We take a boat across the river to the island.

entries.definition_en: moving at a high speed
entries.example_en: The train to Hue is very fast.
entries.example_vi: Tàu đi Huế rất nhanh.
entries.cloze_en: The plane is very fast. It takes us to Hanoi in two hours.

entries.definition_en: on the side of your body where your heart is
entries.example_en: The bank is on the left side of the street.
entries.example_vi: Ngân hàng ở bên trái đường.
entries.cloze_en: Lan writes with her left hand, not her right hand.

entries.definition_en: to sit on a bike, horse or motorbike and move
entries.example_en: Nam rides his motorbike to work.
entries.example_vi: Nam đi xe máy đi làm.
entries.cloze_en: I ride my bike to school every morning.

entries.definition_en: not moving fast
entries.example_en: The bus is slow because of the rain.
entries.example_vi: Xe buýt chạy chậm vì trời mưa.
entries.cloze_en: The bus is very slow today because of the rain, so I am late.

entries.definition_en: to remain in a place for some time
entries.example_en: We stay at a small hotel near the beach.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình ở một khách sạn nhỏ gần biển.
entries.cloze_en: We stay at a small hotel near the beach for three nights.

entries.definition_en: to not move any more
entries.example_en: The bus stops in front of the school.
entries.example_vi: Xe buýt dừng trước cổng trường.
entries.cloze_en: The light is red, so all the cars stop and wait.

entries.definition_en: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
entries.example_en: We take a taxi to the airport.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi taxi ra sân bay.
entries.cloze_en: We call a taxi to take us to the airport.

entries.definition_en: a journey to a place and back
entries.example_en: Our class has a trip to Ha Long Bay.
entries.example_vi: Lớp mình có chuyến đi vịnh Hạ Long.
entries.cloze_en: Our class goes on a trip to Ha Long Bay next week.

entries.definition_en: to change direction
entries.example_en: Turn at the next corner, please.
entries.example_vi: Rẽ ở góc đường tiếp theo nhé.
entries.cloze_en: At the corner, turn right and you can see the bank.

entries.definition_en: to go to the left at a corner
entries.example_en: Turn left at the traffic lights.
entries.example_vi: Đến đèn giao thông thì rẽ trái.
entries.cloze_en: To find the bank, go to the corner and turn left. The bank is on your left.

entries.definition_en: to stay until someone comes or something happens
entries.example_en: Please wait for me at the gate.
entries.example_vi: Đợi mình ở cổng nhé.
entries.cloze_en: I wait for the bus at the bus stop every morning.

entries.definition_en: a building where you pay to sleep when you travel
entries.example_en: The hotel has a big pool.
entries.example_vi: Khách sạn có một bể bơi lớn.
entries.cloze_en: On vacation, we sleep in a hotel near the beach for three nights.

entries.definition_en: to go away from a place
entries.example_en: The train leaves at seven in the morning.
entries.example_vi: Tàu rời ga lúc bảy giờ sáng.
entries.cloze_en: Our train will leave at seven, so please come to the station early.

entries.definition_en: a space or area, like a town or a building
entries.example_en: Hoi An is a beautiful place to visit.
entries.example_vi: Hội An là nơi rất đẹp để tham quan.
entries.cloze_en: Hoi An is a beautiful place to visit.

entries.definition_en: an airplane
entries.example_en: Our plane lands in Da Nang at noon.
entries.example_vi: Máy bay của nhà mình hạ cánh ở Đà Nẵng lúc trưa.
entries.cloze_en: We fly to Da Nang on a big plane.

entries.definition_en: on the side opposite to the left
entries.example_en: Write with your right hand.
entries.example_vi: Viết bằng tay phải nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Lan writes with her right hand, not her left hand.

entries.definition_en: to go to see a person or a place
entries.example_en: We visit our grandparents every Tet.
entries.example_vi: Tết nào nhà mình cũng về thăm ông bà.
entries.cloze_en: Every Tet, we visit our grandparents at their house.

entries.definition_en: to get to a place
entries.example_en: We arrive at the hotel at night.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đến khách sạn lúc tối.
entries.cloze_en: Our plane leaves Hanoi at ten and will arrive in Da Nang at eleven.

entries.definition_en: a building where you watch movies
entries.example_en: There is a new cinema in our town.
entries.example_vi: Thị trấn mình có rạp chiếu phim mới.
entries.cloze_en: We watch a new movie at the cinema on Saturday.

entries.definition_en: a person who drives a car, bus or taxi
entries.example_en: The bus driver is very kind.
entries.example_vi: Bác tài xế xe buýt rất tốt bụng.
entries.cloze_en: The bus driver stops the bus and opens the door for us.

entries.definition_en: to go to the right at a corner
entries.example_en: Turn right after the bridge.
entries.example_vi: Qua cầu thì rẽ phải.
entries.cloze_en: Turn right at the corner. The bank is on your right.

entries.definition_en: a room or building where people work at desks
entries.example_en: My dad works in an office in the city.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình làm việc ở một văn phòng trong thành phố.
entries.cloze_en: My dad works at a desk with a computer in his office.

entries.definition_en: a piece of paper that lets you travel or go in somewhere
entries.example_en: I buy two train tickets to Hue.
entries.example_vi: Mình mua hai vé tàu đi Huế.
entries.cloze_en: You need a ticket to get on the train.

entries.definition_en: to go from one place to another, often far
entries.example_en: My parents like to travel by train.
entries.example_vi: Bố mẹ mình thích đi du lịch bằng tàu hỏa.
entries.cloze_en: My parents like to travel to new places by train.

entries.definition_en: a place where planes come and go
entries.example_en: The airport is far from the city.
entries.example_vi: Sân bay ở xa thành phố.
entries.cloze_en: We go to the airport to take a plane to Hanoi.

entries.definition_en: a vehicle with two wheels that you move with your feet
entries.example_en: Grandpa still rides his old bicycle.
entries.example_vi: Ông vẫn đạp chiếc xe đạp cũ.
entries.cloze_en: Grandpa rides his old bicycle to the market.

entries.definition_en: a special day when people do not work or go to school
entries.example_en: Tet is the biggest holiday of the year.
entries.example_vi: Tết là ngày lễ lớn nhất trong năm.
entries.cloze_en: Tet is a big holiday, and we don't go to school or work.

entries.definition_en: a building where trains or buses stop for people
entries.example_en: The station is busy before Tet.
entries.example_vi: Trước Tết nhà ga rất đông.
entries.cloze_en: We wait for the train at the station.

entries.definition_en: a vehicle with wings that flies in the sky
entries.example_en: My little brother draws an airplane in the sky.
entries.example_vi: Em trai mình vẽ chiếc máy bay trên bầu trời.
entries.cloze_en: We fly to Hanoi on a big airplane with many seats.

entries.definition_en: a structure with walls and a roof, like a house or school
entries.example_en: The tallest building in our city has fifty floors.
entries.example_vi: Tòa nhà cao nhất thành phố mình có năm mươi tầng.
entries.cloze_en: This tall building in the city has fifty floors.

entries.definition_en: a place where sick people get help from doctors
entries.example_en: My aunt is a nurse at the hospital.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình là y tá ở bệnh viện.
entries.cloze_en: My aunt is a doctor, and she works at the hospital.

entries.definition_en: to keep going forward without turning
entries.example_en: Go straight and you will see the park.
entries.example_vi: Cứ đi thẳng là bạn sẽ thấy công viên.
entries.cloze_en: Don't turn left or right. Go straight, and you will see the park.

entries.definition_en: time away from work or school, often for travel
entries.example_en: We go to the beach for our vacation.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi biển trong kỳ nghỉ.
entries.cloze_en: In summer, we go to the beach for our vacation.

entries.definition_en: to or at a distance from a place
entries.example_en: The beach is two hours away by car.
entries.example_vi: Bãi biển cách đây hai tiếng đi ô tô.
entries.cloze_en: The beach is two hours away by car.

entries.definition_en: to the place where you were before
entries.example_en: We come back home on Sunday night.
entries.example_vi: Tối Chủ nhật nhà mình quay về nhà.
entries.cloze_en: We go to Hue on Friday and come back home on Sunday night.

entries.definition_en: at a high speed
entries.example_en: Don't drive too fast in the rain.
entries.example_vi: Đừng lái xe quá nhanh khi trời mưa.
entries.cloze_en: Dad, please don't drive so fast! The street is wet.

entries.definition_en: an idea about what you will do
entries.example_en: What is your plan for the weekend?
entries.example_vi: Kế hoạch cuối tuần của bạn là gì?
entries.cloze_en: What is your plan for the weekend? Do you want to go to the zoo?

entries.definition_en: a short trip on a bike, horse or in a car
entries.example_en: Can I have a ride on your new bike?
entries.example_vi: Cho mình đi thử một vòng xe đạp mới của bạn nhé?
entries.cloze_en: Can I have a ride on your new bike?

entries.definition_en: a place where you can sit
entries.example_en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
entries.example_vi: Xin lỗi, chỗ này có ai ngồi chưa?
entries.cloze_en: Excuse me, is this seat free? Can I sit here?

entries.definition_en: a large boat that carries people or things on the sea
entries.example_en: The big ship goes to the island every day.
entries.example_vi: Con tàu lớn ra đảo mỗi ngày.
entries.cloze_en: The big ship carries people across the sea to the island.

entries.definition_en: a board with words or pictures that gives information
entries.example_en: The sign says the museum is closed.
entries.example_vi: Biển báo ghi bảo tàng đóng cửa.
entries.cloze_en: The sign on the door says the shop is closed.

entries.definition_en: a place where a bus or train stops
entries.example_en: Get off at the next stop.
entries.example_vi: Xuống ở điểm dừng tiếp theo nhé.
entries.cloze_en: We wait at the stop for the number 9 bus.

entries.definition_en: a place where trains stop for people
entries.example_en: Let's meet at the train station at six.
entries.example_vi: Mình gặp nhau ở ga tàu lúc sáu giờ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: We buy tickets at the train station and wait for the train.

entries.definition_en: a place where a road changes direction
entries.example_en: Take the second turn on the left.
entries.example_vi: Rẽ vào chỗ rẽ thứ hai bên trái.
entries.cloze_en: Take the second turn on the left, and the bank is there.

entries.meaning_vi: cuộc đi dạo, quãng đi bộ
entries.definition_en: a trip on foot
entries.example_en: After dinner, we go for a walk.
entries.example_vi: Ăn tối xong cả nhà đi dạo.
entries.cloze_en: After dinner, we go for a walk in the park.

entries.definition_en: toward the right side
entries.example_en: At the corner, go right.
entries.example_vi: Đến góc đường thì đi sang phải.
entries.cloze_en: At the corner, go right, not left.

entries.definition_en: a tall, narrow building
entries.example_en: We can see the whole city from the tower.
entries.example_vi: Từ trên tháp có thể nhìn thấy cả thành phố.
entries.cloze_en: From the top of the tall tower, we can see the city.

entries.definition_en: a big vehicle that carries heavy things
entries.example_en: A big truck brings rice to the market.
entries.example_vi: Một chiếc xe tải lớn chở gạo đến chợ.
entries.cloze_en: A big truck brings rice to the market every morning.

entries.definition_en: a time when you go to see a person or place
entries.example_en: Our visit to Hue is short but fun.
entries.example_vi: Chuyến thăm Huế của nhà mình ngắn nhưng vui.
entries.cloze_en: Our visit to Grandma's house is short but fun.

entries.definition_en: the earth and all the people and countries on it
entries.example_en: I want to travel around the world.
entries.example_vi: Mình muốn đi du lịch vòng quanh thế giới.
entries.cloze_en: I want to travel around the world and see many places.

entries.definition_en: a road that goes over a river or road
entries.example_en: We walk across the old bridge.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình đi bộ qua cây cầu cũ.
entries.cloze_en: We walk across the old bridge over the river.

entries.definition_en: a thing you use to take photos
entries.example_en: Don't forget your camera on the trip.
entries.example_vi: Đi chơi nhớ mang máy ảnh nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Take your camera on the trip so you can take many photos.

entries.definition_en: a train that runs under the ground in a city
entries.example_en: Many people go to work by subway.
entries.example_vi: Nhiều người đi làm bằng tàu điện ngầm.
entries.cloze_en: In big cities, many people go to work by subway under the ground.

entries.definition_en: a building where people go to pray
entries.example_en: We visit an old temple in Hanoi.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi thăm một ngôi chùa cổ ở Hà Nội.
entries.cloze_en: The old temple on the hill has a big bell and many trees.

entries.definition_en: to go onto a bus, train or plane
entries.example_en: Get on the bus quickly, please.
entries.example_vi: Lên xe buýt nhanh nào.
entries.cloze_en: The bus is here. Let's get on and find a seat.

entries.definition_en: thinking about what you do so nothing bad happens
entries.example_en: Be careful when you cross the street.
entries.example_vi: Cẩn thận khi qua đường nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Be careful when you walk across the street. Look left and right.

entries.definition_en: a building where people make things with machines
entries.example_en: My uncle works at a shoe factory.
entries.example_vi: Chú mình làm ở một nhà máy giày.
entries.cloze_en: My uncle works at a factory that makes shoes.

entries.definition_en: from another country
entries.example_en: Many foreign tourists visit Hoi An.
entries.example_vi: Nhiều du khách nước ngoài đến thăm Hội An.
entries.cloze_en: "Hello" is an English word, not a Vietnamese word. For us, it is a foreign word.

entries.definition_en: not inside a building
entries.example_en: Let's play outside. It's sunny.
entries.example_vi: Ra ngoài chơi đi, trời nắng mà.
entries.cloze_en: It's sunny today. Let's go and play outside.

entries.definition_en: in a short time
entries.example_en: Finish your breakfast quickly. The bus is here.
entries.example_vi: Ăn sáng nhanh lên, xe buýt tới rồi.
entries.cloze_en: Eat your breakfast quickly. The bus is here!

entries.definition_en: a building where you watch plays or movies
entries.example_en: We watch a play at the theater.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình xem kịch ở nhà hát.
entries.cloze_en: We buy tickets to see singers at the theater tonight.

entries.definition_en: in a line that does not turn
entries.example_en: Walk straight to the end of the street.
entries.example_vi: Đi thẳng đến cuối phố nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Don't turn left or right. Walk straight, and the bank is there.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of care
entries.example_en: Dad drives carefully in the rain.
entries.example_vi: Bố lái xe cẩn thận khi trời mưa.
entries.cloze_en: Dad drives carefully in the rain because the street is wet.

entries.definition_en: a person from another country
entries.example_en: A foreigner asks me the way to the market.
entries.example_vi: Một người nước ngoài hỏi mình đường đến chợ.
entries.cloze_en: A foreigner on vacation in Hanoi asks me the way to the market.

entries.definition_en: in all places
entries.example_en: At Tet, there are flowers everywhere.
entries.example_vi: Tết đến, đâu đâu cũng có hoa.
entries.cloze_en: At Tet, there are flowers everywhere: in the house, on the street and at the market.

entries.definition_en: walking, not using a car or bike
entries.example_en: My school is near, so I go on foot.
entries.example_vi: Trường gần nên mình đi bộ đến trường.
entries.cloze_en: My school is near my house, so I go on foot every day.

entries.definition_en: a fast plane with jet engines
entries.example_en: A jet flies over our house.
entries.example_vi: Một chiếc máy bay phản lực bay ngang qua nhà mình.
entries.cloze_en: A jet flies very fast high over our house.

entries.definition_en: the part of a street between two corners
entries.example_en: The bank is two blocks from here.
entries.example_vi: Ngân hàng cách đây hai dãy phố.
entries.cloze_en: Our school is one block from my house, so I walk there.

entries.definition_en: a trip in a car
entries.example_en: It's a short drive to the beach.
entries.example_vi: Lái xe ra biển chỉ một đoạn ngắn.
entries.cloze_en: It's a short drive to the beach by car.

entries.definition_en: a round thing that turns under a car or bike
entries.example_en: My bike has a new back wheel.
entries.example_vi: Xe đạp của mình có bánh sau mới.
entries.cloze_en: My bike has a new back wheel.

entries.definition_en: a very large house where a king or queen lives or lived
entries.example_en: We visit the old palace in Hue.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình đi thăm cung điện cổ ở Huế.
entries.cloze_en: We visit the old palace in Hue.
